app.name: OmniFamily Nexus
app.tagline: Your family calendar, tasks and chores — on this device, no account needed.

onboarding.title: Set up your family
onboarding.intro: Everything stays on this device. No email, no password, no account.
onboarding.pinHint: 4–8 digits. Leave empty to skip; you can add one later in Settings.
onboarding.pinDisclosure: A 4-digit PIN has ~10⁴ entropy and is a UX speed bump on a shared screen, not a security boundary.
onboarding.storageDisclosure: IndexedDB is not encrypted at rest in v1; the app relies on OS-level device encryption.

props.account: Start in seconds. No email, no password.
props.offline: Everything works without internet, also on the wall tablet.
props.private: Your family’s data stays on your own devices.

today.shoppingCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to buy} one {# item to buy} other {# items to buy}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.lastParent: The last parent cannot be removed.
settings.parentGate: Settings are for parents. Choose a parent to unlock.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Get a notification 15 minutes before each event. Reminders are created on this device; nothing is sent to a server.
reminders.denied: Notifications are blocked for this app. Allow them in the browser settings.
reminders.foregroundOnly: This browser has no background checks, so reminders arrive while the app is open.
reminders.iosNote: On iPhone and iPad, reminders need the app added to the Home Screen and arrive only while it is open.

pin.label: PIN
pin.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
pin.locked: Locked after too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

errors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.

errors.invalidPoints: Points must be a whole number from 0 to 1000.

groceries.title: Groceries
groceries.name: Item
groceries.toBuy: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to buy} one {# item to buy} other {# items to buy}}

kiosk.title: Family overview
kiosk.setup: This device has no family yet.
kiosk.openHint: Full-screen overview for a tablet on the wall. The screen stays on; leaving it needs a parent PIN.

sync.lanNote: Devices sync directly with each other over the same Wi-Fi network. This version has no cloud relay, so both devices must be on the same network with the app open.
sync.hostStep1: On the other device, open the app, choose “Join an existing family” and scan this code.
sync.hostStep2: Then scan the code that appears on the other device.
sync.textCode: No camera? Copy this code to the other device:
sync.scanning: Point the camera at the code ({received} of {count})
sync.scanningOne: Point the camera at the code
sync.noCamera: This device cannot scan codes. Paste the code instead.

errors.unreadable: That code could not be read. Try again.
errors.wrong_code: That is not the right code for this step.
errors.household_mismatch: That device belongs to another family.
errors.no_household: Neither device has a family yet.
errors.protocol: The devices could not agree. Update both and try again.
errors.timeout: No connection. Are both devices on the same Wi-Fi?

join.title: Join an existing family
join.intro: Bring this device into a family that already uses OmniFamily on another device.
join.step1: On the device that already has the family, open Settings → Devices → “Connect another device”, then scan its code here.
join.step2: Now show this code to the other device.
join.back: Set up a new family instead

sync.connected: Connected. If the numbers match on both screens, you’re done.

intake.label: Quick add
intake.hint: Optional. Typing it in yourself with “New event” always works, also offline.
intake.unavailable: Quick add isn’t available right now. Use “New event” instead — everything else works without it.
intake.offline: You’re offline. Quick add needs a connection; “New event” works offline.
intake.failed: That couldn’t be read. Try different words, or use “New event”.
intake.declined: Nothing was sent. You can use “New event” instead.
intake.lowConfidence: Not sure about this one — please check the details.

consent.title: Allow AI quick add?
consent.intro: Quick add sends what you type to an AI service to turn it into a calendar entry.
consent.what: Only the text you type is sent. Family members’ names are replaced by codes such as P1 before it leaves this device.
consent.retention: The text is not stored or logged by the service; it is used once to make the entry and then discarded.
consent.children: Your entries may be about your children. As a parent or guardian you decide whether to allow this.
consent.revoke: You can withdraw this at any time in Settings → Privacy & data.

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.intro: Your family’s data lives on this device. Nothing is stored on a server.
privacy.consentNone: Not allowed. Quick add asks before it sends anything.
privacy.exportHint: Download everything this device holds about your family. PINs and keys are left out.
privacy.deleteHint: Erase the family vault, keys, cached app files and settings from this device. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteConfirm: Delete ALL family data from this device? This cannot be undone.

toast.imported: {count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} added

add.label: Add
add.title: Add something
add.importHint: From a message, photo or spreadsheet

import.title: Import dates
import.intro: Everything is read on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
import.textLabel: Paste a message, e-mail or list
import.textPlaceholder: e.g. Swimming Saturday 24 October 10:00 for Sem
import.photoHint: A school letter, invitation or screenshot. The first photo downloads the text reader once (about 17 MB); after that it works offline.
import.recognised: Text found in the photo (you can correct it)
import.fileHint: Excel (.xlsx), LibreOffice (.ods) or CSV. A first row with headers such as Date, Time, What, Who works best.
import.unsupported: This file type can’t be read. Save it as .xlsx or .csv and try again.
import.fileError: This file could not be read.
import.found: {count, plural, =0 {No dates found} one {# date found} other {# dates found}}
import.noneHint: Try other text, or add the event yourself.
import.addSelected: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} one {Add # event} other {Add # events}}
import.ocrFailed: The photo could not be read. Try a sharper photo or paste the text instead.
